maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from diagnostic lab testing and drug development/central lab services, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Diagnostics paid mainly by commercial insurers, patients, employers and health systems; biopharma pays for drug development services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic testing volume and drug development, though it regularly buys hospital outreach lab businesses; not main driver.

mission_critical.reason: Clinical diagnostics embedded in provider EHR workflows and regulated clinical trial services make switching costly and disruptive.

notes: Acquisitions of hospital outreach labs are frequent, so serial_acquirer is a borderline judgment.
